answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A basalt of per-task receipts records who did what, and the river of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
